يحتكرون (form VIII)
# يَحْتَكِرُونَ (yaḥtakirūna) /jaħ.ta.ki.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# يُحْتَكَرُونَ (yuḥtakarūna) /juħ.ta.ka.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
